description: This file defines the MatcherReward class within the Goteo project, representing the relation between a Matcher and a Reward, including its status.

classes.name: MatcherReward
classes.description: Represents the association between a Matcher and a Reward with a status property.

methods.name: getMatcher
methods.description: Returns the Matcher object associated with this reward.

methods.name: setMatcher
methods.description: Sets the Matcher object for this reward.

methods.name: getReward
methods.description: Returns the Reward object associated with this reward.

methods.name: setReward
methods.description: Sets the Reward object for this reward.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of this reward relation.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status for this reward relation.
